label: Heavy going
summary: Trump said the US could hit Iran "anytime we want" as the death toll from this week's strikes rose to 18, including two children; Tehran called the strike on a wedding party in Kuhestak a war crime. Russia hit Kyiv for a seventh straight night and struck Odesa, injuring 17. Nepal's flood toll stayed above 1,000 with thousands missing as crews drilled into swamped hydropower tunnels, and UNICEF warned a strengthening El Niño threatens 162 million children in eastern and southern Africa. Oil steadied after a three-day rally, but Asian economies began stockpiling fuel against the next Hormuz shock and Uber cut 3,300 jobs. Against that: Libya's rival factions signed a UN-brokered deal to hold elections, US medical bodies issued independent flu, COVID and RSV vaccine guidance, and a blood test was shown to separate "broken heart syndrome" from heart attacks.
